messages:
Tess - Marketing: Quick thread to lock final announce details for 'Velvet' release. Need: 1) stable changelog URL, 2) canonical docs URL (no redirects), 3) embargo time, 4) webinar timing, 5) UTMs + lead tags. Single-line replies please.

Omar - Eng: Changelog: https://redwood-inference.dev/changelog/velvet-2026-08-11-final. No infra blockers. Note: included a short paragraph on adaptive batching changes.

June - Docs: Canonical docs: https://docs.redwoodinference.com/releases/velvet-2026-08-11 (no redirects). I'll publish once I get the tiny example from Omar. ETA: 45m after snippet.

Omar - Eng: Snippet for docs/blog (use verbatim):
```js
// Velvet release quick generate sample
const out = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood/velvet-13b', prompt: 'Summarize the benchmark findings', max_tokens: 80 });
console.log(out.text);
```
Verified in canary.

Ivy - Growth: Webinar booked 13:30 PT (join 13:25). Recommend embargo lift 13:25 PT so registrants can share. UTMs: utm_campaign=velvet_release&utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=organic. Lead tags: release=velvet, source=webinar, priority=high. Airtable webhook will consume those.

Tess - Marketing: OK — prefer embargo 13:25 to give 5m buffer. Omar: canary timing if deploy starts 09:00 PT? docs need to be live by embargo.

Omar - Eng: Deploy plan: 09:00 deploy -> 09:00-09:20 canary -> 09:20-10:00 progressive rollout -> 10:00 full traffic. Good buffer for 13:25. If canary shows p95 > 2x baseline or error spike > 0.8% we rollback.

June - Docs: Once snippet up I'll merge and publish docs by 10:30 PT. That gives marketing time to proof and set links.

Ivy - Growth: Landing modal copy draft: "Velvet release: live demo of latency & cost wins. Register." Short, punchy. Will post final modal + tracking snippet in #growth.

Tess - Marketing: Also want to highlight the benchmark narrative in the blog: include short chart callout "50% token-cost savings on long-tail conversation workloads"  please confirm numbers are safe to quote. Omar?

Omar - Eng: Confirmed: benchmark internal name "velvet-latency-cost" shows median cost per token ~0.48x baseline for long-tail convs in our test rig. You can phrase as "~50% lower per-token cost on long-tail scenarios in our benchmark suite". Avoid exact lab setup details in public post.

June - Docs: I'll add a small note under "Benchmarks" in docs linking to the benchmark methodology doc (internal) and phrase as Omar suggested.

Ivy - Growth: Inbound routing: please ensure webinar registrants get tags (release=velvet, lead_channel=webinar) and priority=high. Ops to consume via Airtable webhook. I'll DM ops the exact webhook field map.

Tess - Marketing: Who's posting the blog at embargo? I can publish the blog + changelog + docs at 13:25 PT, webinar 13:30. Need a +1 on copy review.

Omar - Eng: +1 on infra notes. I'll monitor rollout 08:30-11:00 PT and stand by for rollback.

June - Docs: +1 to review final blog copy for doc accuracy at 12:00 PT.

release-bot: Deployment scheduled by Omar at 6843209800. Artifact: artifact-velvet-2026-08-11.tar.gz. Canary/rollout config attached.

Tess - Marketing: Great. Final publish plan if green: 13:25 PT blog + changelog + docs go live, 13:30 PT webinar starts, 13:35 PT social posts queue. React with :white_check_mark: to acknowledge this thread as source of truth.

Ivy - Growth: Reacted. Will queue social and send modal.

Omar - Eng: Reacted. Will post canary updates here if anything pops.

June - Docs: Reacted. Will post link to live docs once published.

Tess - Marketing: Locking plan. Thanks team. :sparkles:
